subject: Chemistry
question: According to the wave-particle duality of matter by de-Broglie, which of the following graph plots presents the most appropriate relationship between wavelength of electron (λ) and momentum of electron (p)? (see diagram)
explanation: Explanation: The de-Broglie relationship is λ = h / p. This shows that λ is inversely proportional to momentum p. The graph of two inversely proportional quantities (y = k/x) is a rectangular hyperbola. Therefore, plot (1) correctly represents the relationship.
